  "paraphrased_article": {
    "introduction": `
In a wedding that defied royal tradition, **Princess Märtha Louise of Norway**, the clairvoyant daughter of one of Europe’s most enduring monarchs, tied the knot with **Durek Verrett**, a California-based shaman who claims a six-generation lineage in spiritual practices. Despite the unconventional pairing, crowds gathered along the cloudy streets of **Geiranger** on Saturday, eager to witness the nuptials of the 52-year-old princess—fourth in line to Norway’s throne.`,
    "ceremony_details": `
The ceremony took place in a **traditional Norwegian church** at the upscale **Hotel Union Geiranger**, nestled near the scenic **Geiranger fjord**. Among the attendees were European royalty and celebrities, with the princess accompanied by **seven bridesmaids**, including her daughters **Leah and Emma Behn** from her prior marriage to the late writer **Ari Behn** (divorced in 2017). The **350-guest list** featured prominent figures like Norway’s **Crown Prince Haakon** and **Crown Princess Mette-Marit**, Sweden’s **Crown Princess Victoria** with **Prince Daniel**, and the Netherlands’ **Prince Constantijn** and **Princess Laurentien**.`,
    "princess_background": `
Princess Märtha Louise has long embraced an unconventional path, publicly identifying as a **clairvoyant** and previously operating a **spiritual healing school** where she taught angelic communication. In **2022**, she announced her withdrawal from official royal duties to prioritize her joint ventures with Verrett, aiming to **separate their commercial activities from Norway’s royal institution**.`,
    "groom_background": `
Verrett, 49, brands himself on social media as a **“servant of God”** and **“energy activator”**, counting **Gwyneth Paltrow**—founder of wellness brand **Goop**—among his high-profile clients. He has referred to Paltrow as his **“soul sister”**, further underscoring his eclectic spiritual profile.`
  },

    "tone": "Neutral, descriptive",
    "key_themes": [
      "Unconventional royal wedding",
      "Spiritual and celebrity connections",
      "Norwegian monarchy",
      "Public vs. private royal roles"
    ]
  }
}
